label: Depth-three onset from restricted components
title: A depth-three ring certificate by restricting to carrying components: onset 65 under observation 232, realized by exactly two rules
kind: Exact ring-certificate onset by sparse powers restricted to carrying strong components
summary: The ring criterion only reads (A^m)[v3,v0] for closed violating walks, and every such walk stays inside its strong component, so the eighteenth unit's sparse packed-power onset machinery lifts to depth three by restricting to the carrying components (median 1,726 vertices, max 14,168) instead of the full 65,536-vertex matrix. Onset 65 under observation 232, realized by exactly rules 94 and 133; theorem background and three of four onset bets held, one failed under observations 4 and 32.
takeaway: A ring-certificate question phrased in terms of closed violating walks is governed by the size of the carrying components, not the full pair graph -- a reusable cost reduction, not just a one-off result.
